cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 39 of a typical 36–42 trading days

cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 44 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility

cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 逾期——更大的周期已被拉伸，预计波动加剧
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.

ladder.next_zh: 在加仓前先让下一个日线周期低点形成；留意摆动低点形态。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量为正；但正趋向周线向下交叉；3 日线向下交叉；投资者周期已逾期（投资者周期第 44 周 · 日线周期第 39 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：接近高点。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）

ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.

ladder.age_line: ⏱ NEARING A HIGH signal just triggered today (fresh cross from UNCONFIRMED TURN). Signal strength: faint (score -10/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 接近高点信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自未确认转向翻转）。 信号强度：微弱（评分 -10/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: solid exit setting up (-44)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：稳健离场构筑中（-44）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

accounting_quality.caveat: Annual filings, lagged to the report date; free XBRL is sparse for some filers. Context, not a signal — it does not change the technical call.
accounting_quality.caveat_zh: 年度财报，滞后于披露日；免费 XBRL 数据对部分公司不全。仅供参考，并非交易信号，不改变技术面判断。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

gex_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: negative-gamma tape — dealer hedging amplifies the move (fuel for a breakout)
reasons.zh: 负 Gamma 行情 — 做市商对冲放大波动（利于突破）

reasons.en: short-gamma expansion — realized vol elevated, no suppressive band
reasons.zh: 空头 Gamma 扩张 — 已实现波动升高，无抑制带

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

selection.kind_zh: 盈利 · 内部人 · 评级调整

gex_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: negative-gamma tape — dealer hedging amplifies the move (fuel for a breakout)
reasons.zh: 负 Gamma 行情 — 做市商对冲放大波动（利于突破）

reasons.en: short-gamma expansion — realized vol elevated, no suppressive band
reasons.zh: 空头 Gamma 扩张 — 已实现波动升高，无抑制带

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

entry_signal.headline: Extended — wait for a pullback
entry_signal.headline_zh: 过度拉伸 — 等待回撤
entry_signal.action: Stretched/late — protect gains and don't start new positions; let the next low set up first.
entry_signal.action_zh: 已拉伸／晚期——保护利润，不要新开仓；先等下一个低点构筑成形。

timing.next_trigger: Stretched/late — protect gains and don't start new positions; let the next low set up first.

levels.label_en: 25% over the 200-day (out of the chase zone)
levels.label_zh: 高于200日均线25%（脱离追高区）

pullback_zone.headline_en: Too far above trend to dip-buy — even the non-chase entry sits 27% lower, a different regime rather than a pullback. Wait for the trend to reset, or let it pass.
pullback_zone.headline_zh: 远高于趋势，难以逢低买入 — 即便非追高入场点也在低约 27% 处，是另一种状态而非回调。等趋势重置，或放弃。

headline.en: Rate risk runs through its market / growth beta, not a distinct duration leg.
headline.zh: 其利率风险通过市场／成长beta体现，并无独立的久期暴露。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta -0.08 ± 0.40 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLK) reads duration-neutral (-0.06). Negative inflation beta.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta -0.08 ± 0.40——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLK）为久期中性（-0.06）。 负通胀beta。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。

decision.headline: Extended — don't chase; wait for a pullback
decision.headline_zh: 过度拉升 — 勿追高；等待回撤
decision.gloss: Ran too far, too fast — don't chase; wait for a dip.
decision.gloss_zh: 涨得太快太远——勿追高；等待回撤。

trust.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

timing.text: Stretched/late — protect gains and don't start new positions; let the next low set up first.
timing.text_zh: 已拉伸／晚期——保护利润，不要新开仓；先等下一个低点构筑成形。

decision.conflict_note: Top board rank, but timing blocks a buy now — the rank measures the name, not the moment.
decision.conflict_note_zh: 板内排名靠前，但时机阻碍当前买入——排名衡量个股，而非买入时机。

axes.label: earnings · insider · revisions
axes.label_zh: 盈利 · 内部人 · 评级调整

trend.label: Trend
trend.value_zh: 上行 · 较200日均线 +72% · 逆势
trend.gloss: Where price sits vs its 200-day average, and how strong the trend is (ADX).
trend.gloss_zh: 价格相对200日均线的位置，以及趋势强度（ADX）。

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.gloss_zh: 日线／3日／周线三个周期的动量方向。

extension.label: Extension
extension.gloss: Ran too far above trend — high pullback risk.
extension.gloss_zh: 远高于趋势——回撤风险高。

rel_strength.label: Relative strength
rel_strength.gloss_zh: 相对行业的价格强度——参考。

valuation.label: Valuation
valuation.gloss: Cheap/rich vs the market — context, not a buy signal.
valuation.gloss_zh: 相对大盘的估值——参考，非买入信号。

quality.label: Quality
quality.gloss: Minor accounting flags — keep an eye on them.

positioning.label: Positioning
positioning.value_zh: 内部人卖出 · 做空 4% 流通
positioning.gloss: Insider buying (an edge) and short interest (a risk).
positioning.gloss_zh: 内部人买入（优势）与做空比例（风险）。

squeeze.label: Vol squeeze
squeeze.gloss: Compression → a move is loading; direction unconfirmed until it breaks.
squeeze.gloss_zh: 波动压缩——更大行情正在蓄势；突破前方向未定。

volatility.label: Risk & size
volatility.value_zh: 常见回撤 -3% · 极端 -15% · → 建议仓位 0%
volatility.gloss: Expected downside drives how big to size.
volatility.gloss_zh: 预期下行决定建议仓位大小。

ownership.label: Ownership & flow
ownership.value: 1 active funds · 1 13F holders · distributing (1→1 funds, 6Q) · top-heavy
ownership.value_zh: 1 家主动基金 · 1 家 13F 持有人 · 减仓中（1→1 家，6季） · 高度集中
ownership.gloss: Who owns it and how concentrated; multi-quarter 13F holder trend (lagged ~45d) + how many backtest-skilled funds are buying (descriptive context).
ownership.gloss_zh: 谁在持有、集中度如何；多季度 13F 持有人趋势（滞后约45天）以及有多少回测优质基金在买入（仅供参考）。

macro.label: Macro exposure
macro.gloss: Rate / inflation sensitivity — context, never scored.
macro.gloss_zh: 利率／通胀敏感度——参考，不计分。

catalyst.label: Catalyst
catalyst.gloss: Next earnings date and any earnings/revision edge.
catalyst.gloss_zh: 下次财报日期与盈利／评级优势。
